claims.statement: Tom Allen gave the giant McCoole a magnificent drubbing in one of several fights near St. Louis that Johnny Franklin was responsible for.
claims.excerpt: magnificent drubbing of the giant MecCoole at the hands of the game man, Tom Allen.

claims.statement: Johnny Franklin brought Tom Allen and Coburn together at New Orleans for a match.
claims.excerpt: he brought Allen and Coburn together at New Orleans.

fights.excerpt: magnificent drubbing of the giant MecCoole at the hands of the game man, Tom Allen.
fights.notes: Date not given. Franklin arranged several fights near St. Louis; this one is named only as a win by Allen.

notes: Life story of Johnny Franklin, so all Allen claims are retrospective. Hint 2 said 1872, but the text gives no date for the New Orleans match and calls Coburn only by surname. Hint 1 is kept as a fight with the opponent as printed (McCoole, no first name in the text).
